summary: Parametric contour spline, chord arclength, gradient and corrected curvature=(bhat dot grad)bhat

identity.direction: Declared inputs to Object exposing verts,tck,u and arclength/field diagnostics
identity.definition: kappa = sign(tangent dot bhat) d(bhat)/ds. Interpolate BR,BZ at query points, then normalize; use actual polygonal arclength. Normalizing before interpolation caused the preserved coarse-grid counterexample.
identity.model: Distinct source variant: Filters nonfinite grid Q before griddata; constructor accepts u,s=0,k=2,npts=1000; physical components are sampled before normalization; open cyclic permutations removed.
identity.geometry: One-dimensional or planar sampled geometry as explicitly stated
identity.coordinates: Planar R,Z in coherent length units; contour psi is a label
identity.boundary: Closed periodic spline; supplied-order open paths; finite fitted-parameter crossings only.
assumptions: Finite contour vertices sufficient for SciPy splprep
Corrected d_ds requires N>=3 and distinct adjacent vertices
Curvature requires finite nonzero tangent-aligned B at line points
Grid interpolation queries lie inside finite input support

preconditions: Finite contour vertices sufficient for SciPy splprep
Corrected d_ds requires N>=3 and distinct adjacent vertices
Curvature requires finite nonzero tangent-aligned B at line points

supported: Named analytic, manufactured, invariant or reference fixtures in the direct tests

The original 80x80/257 circular consumer passes at the unchanged rtol=0, atol=2.5e-3 gate for both field and vertex reversals; corrected max component error is 4.0968e-5. An asymmetric held-out ellipse is 1.1255e-4; these named cases do not guarantee arbitrary-grid accuracy.
excluded: Intersection is bounded to fitted parameter intervals and rejects no-crossing/multiple-root cases; tangency/completeness remains unqualified
Arbitrary contour topology, magnetic-axis limit and physical stability are unqualified
get_kappa_n_2 requires uniform xy grid and nonzero flux gradient
Polar projection is supplied separately with explicit theta and origin failure; no topology or magnetic-axis claim is inferred.

failure_semantics.invalid_input: ValueError for nonfinite/null interpolated B or zero tangent projection; d_ds rejects duplicate adjacent vertices. get_kappa_n_2 rejects nonuniform/nonseparable/nonfinite grids and zero flux-gradient support. Other SciPy constructor/interpolation errors propagate.
failure_semantics.runtime_failure: Underlying numerical or interpolation exceptions propagate.
failure_semantics.nonconvergence: Bounded multistart distance solve accepts a crossing only when separation is within geometry-scaled tolerance; no found crossing or multiple found crossings raises ValueError. Finite search does not certify all spline roots or tangencies.
failure_semantics.partial_results: apply_boundary commits both parameter bounds only after both solves succeed; a failed update leaves existing bounds unchanged.

provenance.lineage_summary: Selectively recovered from the exact earlier D2 source, derived from frozen Pleiades analysis/fltools.py. Earlier coarse-grid error 0.00691073 exceeded the original 2.5e-3 gate. D2 repair samples physical B before normalization, retains tangent-oriented arclength derivative and distinct class return/API contracts, removes open-path cyclic jumps and rejects numerical noncrossings. Original failures are preserved as evidence, not exported legacy behavior.
